In the first example, the first query describes a simul in which player $$$1$$$ plays against player $$$2$$$ (and no one else). The answer to the query is $$$1$$$, meaning that player $$$1$$$ won the only game they played. We can conclude that $$$1$$$ beats $$$2$$$. Other players can win in the same fashion.

In the second example, the third query describes a simul in which player $$$1$$$ plays against every other player. The answer to the query is $$$4$$$, meaning that they won every game they played. It can be concluded that player $$$1$$$ also beats every other player.
